JobOwners.admitted_bounded.detail: A nonempty one-job table admits its second entry under cap2. These laws concern the runtime-called admission gate, not complete concurrent IO refinement, OS completion or whole-app resource bounds.

JobOwners.full_refuses.detail: A full one-job table refuses a stateful factory and leaves state8 unchanged. These laws concern the runtime-called admission gate, not complete concurrent IO refinement, OS completion or whole-app resource bounds.

JobOwners.available_creates.detail: The same nonempty table under cap2 runs the actual supplied factory, returning7 and advancing state8 to9. These laws concern the runtime-called admission gate, not complete concurrent IO refinement, OS completion or whole-app resource bounds.
